verdict.rationale: No evidence item names an official Grafana SDK. The closest support is an official OpenAPI spec (from which clients could be generated), observability-as-code docs on defining dashboards and data sources in code via CI/CD, and an official CLI for programmatic and terminal workflows. These are adjacent building blocks rather than SDKs. Missing for 10: explicitly documented official SDKs (e.g., language client libraries), SDK reference docs, and hands-on or independent corroboration of building against them.
